title: Task-record ship does not run the recorded task's Proof
body: Outcome: `krn pr ship` (and `krn task publish`) on a pull request that only adds or edits task records under tasks/ never runs the Proof of the task it records; it ships on the required Check alone.

Why: a publish retry of t-n3t8wag through `krn pr ship` ran that task's Proof (`krn skills check`, a command the task itself will build) and refused with exit 81, blocking the record from reaching main (predecessor handoff 2026-11-18).
Proof: a test ships a task-records-only change whose task Proof names a missing command and asserts the ship is not refused with 81; a code PR carrying `Ticket:` still runs the Proof.
